theme: 3 terms on low memory: the warning, the self-cleaning cache, and the removal of old items

terms.definition: A signal from iOS that the device is running low on memory.
terms.example: Clear the image cache when the app gets a Memory Warning.

terms.definition: A dictionary-like object that stores temporary data and clears items by itself when memory is low.
terms.example: Store the thumbnails in an NSCache, not in a plain dictionary.

terms.definition: The removal of old items from a cache to free memory.
terms.example: Cache Eviction started, so the old thumbnails are gone.
terms.code:
let cache = NSCache<NSString, NSString>()
cache.setObject("Mina", forKey: "user")
cache.removeAllObjects()
print(cache.object(forKey: "user") ?? "empty")

video.title: Memory Warning, NSCache & Cache Eviction | Day 126
video.description:
Learn to explain how an iOS app reacts when memory runs low: Memory Warning, NSCache & Cache Eviction, with real code, a quiz at the end and each example read twice (normal, then slow).

Today's terms
Memory Warning - A signal from iOS that the device is running low on memory.
NSCache - A dictionary-like object that stores temporary data and clears items by itself when memory is low.
Cache Eviction - The removal of old items from a cache to free memory.

Quiz at the end - write your answers in the comments, then watch again to check.

landscape.description:
Explain Memory Warning, NSCache & Cache Eviction in iOS by listening to a real code chat between two iOS devs.
메모리 경고, NSCache, 캐시 퇴출 표현을 영어 대화로 익혀요.

Memory Warning - A signal from iOS that the device is running low on memory.
한국어: 메모리 경고: 기기의 메모리가 부족하다는 iOS의 신호

NSCache - A dictionary-like object that stores temporary data and clears items by itself when memory is low.
한국어: NSCache: 메모리가 부족하면 스스로 항목을 지우는 임시 데이터용 딕셔너리 같은 객체

Cache Eviction - The removal of old items from a cache to free memory.
한국어: 캐시 퇴출: 메모리를 확보하려고 캐시에서 오래된 항목을 지우는 것

landscape.hook: Can you explain Memory Warning, NSCache and Cache Eviction in English?

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Jake, the app crashed on an old iPhone after scrolling photos.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Use NSCache instead. It removes items by itself when memory is low.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: How does it decide what to remove?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: That is Cache Eviction. iOS removes old items first, but you do not control the order.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Should I also react to a Memory Warning?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes, like in the code. Clear the cache in `didReceiveMemoryWarning`.

lines.speaker: A
lines.text: Is a Memory Warning a crash?

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: No, it is only a signal. If you ignore it, iOS may close your app.

lines.speaker: B
lines.text: Yes. Set `countLimit` on the NSCache, so Cache Eviction starts earlier.
